items.title: Turning back the clock: F1’s youngest world champions
items.summary: Kimi Antonelli’s sensational sophomore season has seen him crowned the youngest Formula 1 world champion in history. It’s a record that has only progressed through 10 different drivers, and at 16 years since the age was last lowered, Antonelli ends the second-longest gap between new benchmarks.
